

Energy proportions are aggregated into broad categories:


Scope 1 energy categories

• Biogenic fuels: include all solid, liquid and gas biomass fuels

• Fossil fuels: include all solid, liquid and gas fossil fuels used in on-site

   combustion.

• Other: Include use of municipal solid waste, renewable heat (not

   including CHP), and other unspecified energy sources.


Scope 2 energy categories

• Electricity (Standard): is grid electricity. Depending on the supplier

  location, or individual power purchase agreements, this can include

  renewable energy supplied through the grid

• Purchased steam, heat and cooling

• Renewable electricity

If selected, data from incomplete submissions will be included. This means:


• If a supplier provided partial data, the

• If a supplier has not yet provided any data, an
